title: Now, Master, Let Your Servant Depart

request.style: English, a cappella choral anthem, mixed SATB choir with solo tenor, sacred and luminous, slow and peaceful, 60 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Now, Master, you may let your servant depart in peace
According to your word
For my eyes have seen your salvation
Which you have prepared in the sight of all peoples

[Chorus]
A light for revelation to the Gentiles
And the glory of your people Israel
